Overview

Beersheba is a city in HaDarom with a population of 210,000. The largest city in southern Israel, capital of the Negev desert, and a growing center for cyber-tech and academia. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 320 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
